event.title: string
event.weekdays: array of ISO weekdays Monday=1 through Sunday=7
event.count: null or positive maximum occurrence count
event.remindersMinutes: array of nonnegative minute offsets, at most 3

normalization: Occurrences sorted by startTS,endTS,title; reminders sorted by occurrenceTS,notifyAtMillis. Operations execute in order before query. All synthetic, local calendar only. Recurrence and exception behavior must be inferred from APK. nextReminders represents planned next scheduling request per surviving stored event, not notification delivery. Missing changes preserve occurrence fields. Return empty arrays when no results. roundTrip serializes and reloads implementation state before subsequent operations/query.
